_comment: Known, deliberate deviations from the Qt baseline (testdata/corpus-baseline.json). Every entry records a Phase-4 decision: the divergence was root-caused and the native value kept on purpose. Ground truth throughout is desktop MuseScore Studio 4.7.4 (--score-meta / MIDI export on the same scores). Updated 2026-08-29, Phase 4: the volta/slurs midiBytes waivers are gone (mscz2media now runs Score::update() after layout, matching the desktop/webmscore pipeline; exports are byte-identical); the duration waivers stay because the *baseline* is wrong: webmscore computes saveMetadata().duration from a stale repeat-list cache (Score::duration() mixes repeatList(true) with the expandRepeats-flag-dependent repeatList() inside utick2utime) - calling saveMidi first flips webmscore to the desktop values, which are exactly what the native engine reports. bigTimeSig-3/4 stay because desktop lays them out at 2 pages like the native engine; the Qt-webmscore 1-page count is the outlier. vibrato-1 and text-line-scaling are genuine native deviations: a tight system-break flips on sub-percent glyph-advance differences (HarfBuzz/FreeType vs Qt measures e.g. the guitarVibrato wiggle at 246.83 vs 247.61 units), pushing one measure to the next system and the last system to page 2; desktop agrees with Qt here.

bigTimeSig-3.mscz.pages: desktop 4.7.4 lays out 2 pages, same as native; the Qt-webmscore 1-page baseline is the outlier

bigTimeSig-4.mscz.pages: desktop 4.7.4 lays out 2 pages, same as native; the Qt-webmscore 1-page baseline is the outlier

breath-4.mscz.meta.duration: native 23s matches desktop 4.7.4; the 19s baseline is webmscore's stale-cache duration (breath pauses missing from the cached repeat-list times)

partials.mscz.meta.duration: native 14s matches desktop 4.7.4; the 18s baseline is webmscore's stale-cache duration

partials2.mscz.meta.duration: native 14s matches desktop 4.7.4; the 18s baseline is webmscore's stale-cache duration

stacking-order.mscz.meta.duration: native 26s matches desktop 4.7.4; the 53s baseline is webmscore's stale-cache duration (expanded utick looked up in the non-expanded list)

text-line-scaling.mscz.pages: tight system-break flip from sub-percent HarfBuzz-vs-Qt advance differences: native fits 20 instead of 22 measures on the single system (1 page Qt/desktop -> 2 native)

vibrato-1.mscz.pages: tight system-break flip from sub-percent HarfBuzz-vs-Qt advance differences: system 2 fits 6 instead of 7 measures (1 page Qt/desktop -> 2 native)
